name: get_status
description: Reports the current state of an app's most recent deployment, in plain language — never raw internal status words.

status.description: Raw internal status, included for programmatic branching by the calling agent. Do not display this to a human — use `stage` instead.

stage.description: Plain-language label for `status`, from deployment-ui-state.mjs's stageLabelForStatus — e.g. "Building your app". This, not `status`, is what should be shown to a person.

active.description: True while the deployment is still in progress; the agent should keep polling.

terminal.description: True once the deployment has reached a final state (LIVE, FAILED, or DELETED) and will not change further.

url.description: Live URL, present only when status is LIVE.

message.description: One plain-language sentence summarizing the current state.

diagnostic.description: Present only when something needs attention (status FAILED, or a blocking error). The single-action-prompt pattern: one plain-language title and one action, never a stack trace.
